_doc: Q24 (quick 261015-j0n) uninitialized-state WARNINGS in committed, frozen patches (never edited to satisfy critics; fix-plan rule 3). Q24 is a blocker only for a new file (review_patch(..., is_new=True), set by the save gate for a file with no baseline); on these committed files review_patch reports it as a warning. tests/test_uninitialized_state.py::TestCommittedCorpus pins every committed .maxpat/.maxhelp file: it fails on any new, missing or stale entry and on a missing reason, and checks each entry's maxclass against the box (guards id drift). Matching key: patch path + box_id + CriticResult path ("" at the top level). Unlike review_blocker_allowlist.json and validate_error_allowlist.json, calibration (user-confirmed) projects may appear here because every entry is a warning (granularsynthtest obj-26 is a spec latent case).
